The strongest candidate was carbon_pct (within-lab linear t=-1.61, spline p=0.036, robust p=0.095, largest within-lab ΔR²), while cool_rate's raw correlation (r=0.29) was confounded by lab (R²_by_lab=0.247). The pre-registered confirmatory OLS of tensile_mpa on carbon_pct plus lab indicators on held-out data gave estimate -0.204 (SE 0.115), p=0.076, which is not significant at alpha=0.05. Therefore no direct effect is confirmed.
